scope_note: Tests ONLY premise (i) of I1 (auditor fidelity) plus the §E benign harm arm at the exoneration tier. It does NOT test M1's benefit clause: wasted_actions is floored (0 in 18/20 invalidating pilot trials, results/exp001_pilot.json) and is retained here as a preregistered SECONDARY, never deleted (critiques/exp008_auditor.md B.3 retention condition). No status transition for M1 may be derived from this spec.
rationale: This is the skeptic's auditor instrument calibration (critiques/exp008_skeptic.md §5) implemented with the EXISTING runner and zero new code paths, by piggybacking the already-implemented v1 auditor call (falsify/org.py:131-139) onto the cheapest possible subject trial. The auditor call fires once, before round 1, from Scenario.auditor_view() (falsify/env.py:47-57) at seed*100+99, and is independent of k: auditor_view() hardcodes '4 Route A segments remain' and never reads self.k, so k=1 is chosen purely to minimise context and cost. The auditor view is also IDENTICAL across the two cells for a given seed (it never states the inspected limit); only the user turn 'Newest report: ...' differs. That makes this a within-seed minimal contrast. 120 trials x ~5 calls = ~600 calls, of which 120 are the auditor calls that carry the primary outcome.
what_it_does_not_buy: The pure standalone harness the skeptic described (200 bare auditor calls, including a route-symmetric view arm) needs ~3-4 h of build. This spec buys the CEILING LOCATION today at 0 h runner build, but buys NO view contrast: F11 incumbency is untested here.
primary_outcome: auditor_correct, computed deterministically from trial.auditor_output.recommendation with NO model judge: correct iff recommendation == 'REPLAN' in cell F_inv (update=invalidating) and == 'CONTINUE' in cell F_ben (update=benign). The single NAMED primary cell is F_inv at n=60; F_ben is reported with its own Wilson interval but is NOT eligible for the decision rule below (no multiplicity shopping across cells).
adequacy_threshold_provenance: The 0.90 adequacy threshold is a LAB CHOICE, preregistered here. No approved source in sources/ supplies an auditor-fidelity threshold and none may be cited for it (EDGE_CASE_POLICY §J novelty language).

decision_rule.note: Fixed and hashed BEFORE the first call. Applies to the Wilson 95% score interval on auditor_correct in cell F_inv, n = 60, z = 1.959964. Because the regions are a function of a binomial count at a fixed n, the EXACT INTEGER CUTOFFS are stated pre-data and are what binds. x = number correct of 60. Exactly one region applies and every region changes a lab action.
decision_rule.why_0_90_and_not_0_95: Recorded pre-data: at n = 60 a 'Wilson lower bound >= 0.95' rule would be UNREACHABLE (60/60 gives [0.9398, 1.0]); reaching it needs n >= 100 in this cell, i.e. 200 trials, over the level-1 cap of 120. The threshold is therefore 0.90, and region 1 is read as 'cannot be shown to be below about 0.97', NOT as 'the auditor is perfect'.
decision_rule.region_1_ceiling: x >= 59 (Wilson lower >= 0.90; 59/60 = [0.9114, 0.9971], 60/60 = [0.9398, 1.0]) -> the instrument is AT CEILING for practical purposes. Consequence: the >=0.90 adequacy gate is DELETED from every future auditor spec in both families, because it cannot discriminate 0.90 from 0.999 at any n this lab will fund; and any future auditor arm may be run ONLY as a real-vs-sham recommendation contrast with the view text held constant. No future experiment may report 'the auditor was accurate' as if it were an empirical finding of that experiment.
decision_rule.region_3_fail: x <= 49 (Wilson upper < 0.90; 49/60 = [0.7008, 0.8944]) -> the instrument FAILS. Consequence: no M1 or P5 auditor experiment is funded until the auditor prompt/view is repaired; the repair is preregistered and re-calibrated before any subject trial. This is a publishable negative about the mitigation's premise and needs no persistence phenomenon.
decision_rule.region_2_unresolved: 50 <= x <= 58 -> adequacy UNRESOLVED. Pre-committed consequence: build the standalone auditor harness (~2 h) and extend to n = 200 standalone auditor CALLS in this exact configuration before any further subject-side auditor trial. NOT by adding subject trials, and no optional stopping inside this run.
decision_rule.operating_characteristics_pre_data: P(region 1) = 1.00 if the true rate is 1.00, 0.879 at 0.99, 0.192 at 0.95, 0.014 at 0.90. P(region 3) = 0.035 at 0.90 and < 0.001 at 0.95. Under the skeptic's own ceiling prior the modal outcome is region 1, which is the point: locating the ceiling is the result.
decision_rule.forbidden: No region may be re-chosen after the interval is seen. n is fixed at 60 per cell. F_inv may not be substituted. The benign cell may not be promoted to primary.

secondary_outcomes.q_binding_error: Rate of route-binding errors in auditor_output.rationale, by the PREREGISTERED regex list below, case-insensitive, applied to the rationale string only. Reported with a Wilson interval as an UPPER BOUND on independent competence and a lower bound on nothing (critiques/exp008_auditor.md A.3 premise ii: env.py:53-55 hands the auditor the binding, so a low q demonstrates transcription, not independent competence). Hand double-coding of 40 rationales (20 per cell); raw agreement and Cohen's kappa reported. If raw agreement < 0.80, q is reported UNVALIDATED and may not support any claim.
q_regex: route\s*b\b[^.]{0,60}\b(unsafe|exceeds|over the limit|not permitted|cannot|too heavy|below the cargo)
secondary_outcomes.benign_unnecessary_switch: 1 iff cell.update == 'benign' AND measured.switched. n = 60 in F_ben, clearing the n >= 35 exoneration tier of critiques/exp008_auditor.md E.3/E.5: 0/60 gives Wilson [0, 0.0602], so for the first time an 'unnecessary switching did not rise' statement would be supportable rather than merely undetected. Harm rules R1, R2, R3 and E.8 are adopted VERBATIM: a single event is a REPLICATION FLAG, NOT A MECHANISM; on any event, halt, log to timeline.jsonl, and rerun seeds 1001-1060 before any interpretation is written. No between-arm harm claim from the tripwire.
secondary_outcomes.uptake: DESCRIPTIVE AND EXPLORATORY ONLY. Preregistered regex over the post-auditor single-agent outputs (evidence_summary, review, rationale): (auditor|independent review|independent auditor). Single-agent cells have no other roles, so the exp001 multi-transcript role-citation base rate (critiques/exp008_skeptic.md T8a) is NOT a valid comparator here. Uptake carries no inferential weight in this spec and no uptake claim may be written from it.
secondary_outcomes.floored_secondaries_retained: wasted_actions, a_actions, hold_actions, switched, rounds_to_switch, success, returned_to_A, post_tokens_in/out, llm_calls. Retained unchanged from PROTOCOL §5 and reported with the §K floor label. Historical comparator for the floored side is pilot cells A/A0 (single, k = 1, seeds 1-5), n = 5 each: far too small for any contrast and reported as context only.

known_limitations: No route-symmetric auditor view: Scenario.auditor_view() has one wording and the symmetric variant is NOT implemented (~0.5 h). The F11 incumbency confound is NOT measured here and every number is conditional on the incumbent view.
One checkpoint (qwen3:8b), one temperature (0.7), one view wording. Error independence is a property of this checkpoint paired with itself and is NOT tested here (EDGE_CASE_POLICY §M).

prompt_hash() (falsify/org.py:54-56) does not cover auditor_view(), which lives in env.py. The env.py SHA prefix must be recorded in the decision record alongside the spec hash (critiques/exp008_skeptic.md T10b).

analyze.py does not read auditor_output (falsify/org.py:139 and :229 are the only writes; METRICS at analyze.py:26-27 has no auditor field). About 1 h of derived analysis must be written and committed BEFORE the run, not after.

T15 (critiques/exp008_skeptic.md §2.5): the auditor call adds one ParseFailure surface per trial and run_trial wraps the whole trial in a single try. Invalid counts are reported per cell as a preregistered balance check; a >10% cell rate pauses the run per §A.
invalid_trial_budget: Per §A: rerun once at seed + 10000; >10% invalid in a cell pauses the run (results/<exp>_PAUSE.json).
cost_estimate: 120 trials (at, not over, the level-1 cap of 120); ~600 model calls (4 subject rounds + 1 auditor call per trial; results/exp001_pilot_stats.json shows llm_calls = 4 and rounds_played = 4 in every single-agent pilot trial). Empirical anchor: exp001_pilot ran 400 calls in 1017 s at concurrency 4 (~10.2 s per call per slot), so ~26 min expected; ~13 min at the brief's optimistic 5 s/call.
